pages.text: Two shader packs ship with the pack: $(l)Complementary Reimagined$() (selected) and $(l)BSL$(). Press $(l)K$() to turn shaders on.$(br2)The pack runs $(l)Sodium$(), $(l)Lithium$(), $(l)FerriteCore$(), $(l)ModernFix$() and $(l)Entity Culling$() so it stays smooth with all this content.

If frames dip:$(li)Lower render distance to 12 (Video Settings)$(li)Turn shaders off with $(l)K$()$(li)Lower Entity Distance in Video Settings$(br2)Memory is set to 8 GB in Prism (Edit Instance > Settings).
